about_the_game:
Are you ready to find 500 adorable cats lost in a colorful birthday bash? Explore 5 unique maps filled with hand-drawn scenes of cakes, balloons, gifts, and party decorations. Discover cats hiding in these scenes and color each one by numbers to brighten this joyful celebration!

Each map offers a lively and festive birthday atmosphere with vibrant colors and detailed hand drawings. Can you find the cats hidden in this party world?

🎨 After finding them, color each scene only by numbers. Experience this special day with the relaxing power of colors and birthday cheer!

✨ Features:

🎉 5 unique birthday bash maps

🐱 500 hidden cats in total

🎨 Paint-by-numbers system

🧘‍♀️ Relaxed gameplay without time pressure

🎧 Special themed birthday radio broadcast

🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Play online duo with a friend
